title: EnumDraft3TypeNames
description: Issue #145 on the dialect whose "type" says two things nothing else does. "any" is a type name with no Go type of its own, so the enum's base came out `any` and the const form declared `const X Root = "a"` against it -- `invalid constant type`, and a Validate whose receiver was an interface. And a draft 3 type array may hold whole schemas, which widen the union past the names the list carries, so a member matching none of the names may still match one of those. Nothing is filtered on either row; both are here to say so.

anyTyped.$comment: "any" admits every member there is, so the list survives whole and only the form it is emitted in changes. Dropping a member here would refuse a document the schema states.

typeAlternatives.$comment: The names on this list are "string" alone; the integer alternative is a schema, held apart from them. Reading the names as the whole of the type would drop 5, which the alternative admits.
